name: Stream Likes compliance data
description: Stream Likes compliance data Streams all compliance data related to Likes for Users. GET /2/likes/compliance/stream
context:
GET /2/likes/compliance/stream
Streams all compliance data related to Likes for Users.
Optional: backfill_minutes (query) — The number of minutes of backfill requested.; start_time (query) — YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ. The earliest UTC timestamp from which the Likes Compliance events will be provided.; end_time (query) — YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ. The latest UTC timestamp from which the Likes Compliance events will be provided.
